_about: Derived but tracked, on data/geo/'s precedent: pdfs/ are symlinks outside the repository, so a clone cannot rebuild this. Built by tools/extract_scans.py --commit. Per page: `master` is the full-page image scans/ is cut from, `offset` is the integer shift from the legacy pdftoppm render space into master space (master = render - offset), and `images` are the embedded photographs with `rect` in MASTER pixels, rounded outward. `rendered: true` marks the three masterless RGB pages, which are rasterised at 300 dpi as before and do not move.
